newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Oriental Metals down on interim loss.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Metals down on interim loss.

text.p: Shares of China-backed non-ferrous metal trading concern Oriental Metals (Holdings) Co Ltd fell on disappointed selling after it reported an interim loss, brokers said on Monday.
"Investors were seen switching out from the stock in the wake of a sharp interim loss," said a local sales manager.
The shares fell HK$0.14 or 11.02 percent to its intraday low of HK$1.13 ahead of close with 1.77 million shares traded.
The company posted an interim loss of HK$32.70 million for the first half of 1996, compared with HK$40.38 million profit the same period a year ago. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
